paper_statement: For the strong four-model ensemble, OW-L has 73.66%, 90.37%, and 85.78% accuracy on UltraFeedback, MMLU, and ARMMAN, exceeding MV at 72.21%, 89.32%, and 85.24%.
acceptance_for_verified: use the exact retained examples and recorded shuffle maps
use the exact four named model revisions and inference settings
regenerate or obtain the exact per-example model predictions
run an independently checked implementation of OW-L and MV
reproduce the six reported rounded accuracies from raw predictions
acceptance_for_falsified: use the same exact retained examples, labels, shuffle maps, model revisions, inference settings, and OW-L definition
produce a reproducible contradiction of at least one reported point value or superiority relation
exclude stochastic-output drift and implementation mismatch as explanations
